name: River Lanterns
description: Paper lanterns drifting down a river at night, each with a long wavering reflection; by day they become paper boats.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of lanterns on a frame of about 960 by 480 pixels. Larger and smaller frames scale it by area.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the current, the turning and the movement of the water.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the lantern light at night, and the faint tint of some paper boats by day. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the river. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the river. Pressing the water anywhere outside links, buttons and fields launches a new lantern from that point.
